|game_text=Deploy on Han. I've Got a Bad Feeling About This is cancelled. When fired, Han is '''cumulatively''' power +1 until end of turn. May target a character or creature for free. Draw destiny. Target hit, forfeit = 0 and opponent loses 1 Force if destiny +1 > defense value.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 3). No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB8-03-Hans_Blaster_So_Uncivilized-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 9 November 2026). The original is [[Han's Blaster, So Uncivilized]]; the current text is [[Han's Blaster, So Uncivilized (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2).
* '''Original''' ([[Han's Blaster, So Uncivilized]]): Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet, official text as of 11 May 2012<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 11 May 2012"; the surviving copy was re-made 18 July 2012). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on Han. I've Got A Bad Feeling About This is canceled. When fired, Han is cumulatively power +1 until end of turn. May target a character or creature for free. Draw destiny. Target hit, its forfeit = 0 and opponent loses 1 Force if destiny +1 > defense value.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-03-Hans_Blaster_So_Uncivilized.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-hansblastersouncivilized-pre.gif]]) print it. The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Light Side p. 54) prints this text again, identical character for character<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>. An exact reprint of an earlier text is a stale reprint: it is not a new version and does not make this text current again (wiki versions ruling, 9 November 2026).
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC website card list, from 21 July 2012 (the earliest archived capture with game text): on the Virtual Block 8 list until that list changed (by 12 December 2012), and on the Virtual master list in every capture to 11 January 2013<ref name="cl-1281_46-e1">Players Committee website card list: VBlock8Type (Virtual Block 8 list), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 21 July 2012]; VMasterType (Virtual master list), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013] (Internet Archive); the archived captures from March 2013 on carry no game text</ref>: “Deploy on Han. I've Got a Bad Feeling About This is cancelled. When fired, Han is cumulatively power +1 until end of turn. May target a character or creature for free. Draw destiny. Target hit, forfeit = 0 and opponent loses 1 Force if destiny +1 > defense value.” '''What changed:''' “I've Got A Bad Feeling” is written “I've Got a Bad Feeling” (lower-case “a”), “canceled” is spelled “cancelled”, and “its” is dropped before “forfeit = 0”. The text list writes icons out in words and cannot show italics, bold or curly quotes; differences that come only from that are not changes.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Han's Blaster, So Uncivilized (Errata 2)]]): PC website card list, Virtual Block 8 list, from the capture of 12 December 2012 to 11 January 2013<ref name="cl-1281_46-e2">Players Committee website card list: VBlock8Type (Virtual Block 8 list), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212003733/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 12 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142925/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 11 January 2013] (Internet Archive); the archived captures from March 2013 on carry no game text</ref>: “Deploy on Han. I've Got a Bad Feeling About This is canceled. When fired, Han is cumulatively power +1 until end of turn. May target a character or creature for free. Draw destiny. Target hit, forfeit = 0 and opponent loses 1 Force if destiny +1 > defense value.” '''What changed:''' “cancelled” is spelled “canceled” again; the rest is the PC-E1 text. From 12 December 2012 to at least 11 January 2013 the two lists showed different texts at the same time (PC-E1 on the Virtual master list, PC-E2 on the Virtual Block 8 list), so the two versions overlap. No card image shows either text; PC-E2 is the latest because it is the later change (wiki versions ruling, 9 November 2026).
